name: Bera
title: Son of Asher
summary: Bera was one of the sons of Asher, Jacob's son, and became a head of an important clan in the tribe of Asher. His descendants, the Beraites, became a prominent family in Israel. The name Bera also appears in connection with other people in the Bible, including a son of Ephraim and a Benjaminite.

keyEvents.title: Bera's birth and place in Asher's lineage
keyEvents.description: Bera is mentioned as one of the four sons of Asher who traveled with Jacob to Egypt. He was part of the family that settled in Goshen.

keyEvents.title: Listing among Jacob's descendants
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Bera is listed as a son of Asher along with his brothers and sister Serah.

keyEvents.title: Bera's sons Heber and Malkiel
keyEvents.description: Bera's two sons, Heber and Malkiel, became ancestors of important clans within the tribe of Asher. Malkiel is considered the father of Birzait.

keyEvents.title: The Beraite clan at the census
keyEvents.description: During the census in the plains of Moab, Bera's descendants, the Beraites, were counted as a distinct clan within the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's son named Bera
keyEvents.description: Another Bera is mentioned as a son of Ephraim, named in sorrow because disaster had struck his household when his brothers were killed by men from Gath.

keyEvents.title: Benjamite Bera in Aijalon
keyEvents.description: A third Bera is mentioned as a son of Elpaal, a Benjamite and leader in Aijalon, who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
